english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for approving or supporting a proposal, decision, or course of action.

english.meaning: agree, be of the same opinion
english.note: Use this mainly when agreeing with and supporting a proposal, decision, or course of action.
Use this when “believe in” means approving of something or considering it right or desirable.

examples.english: I approve of you doing it this way.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 nei5 dei6 gam2 joeng2 zou6

examples.english: I concur with holding the meeting tomorrow, so everyone can be prepared.
examples.traditional: 我贊成聽日先開會，等大家準備好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 ting1 jat6 sin1 hoi1 wui2 dang2 daai6 gaa1 zeon2 bei6 hou2

examples.english: I believe this is the right approach.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3
